images.title: The Four Gates at Blue Hour

observations.scene: A dark timber church, a low enclosing wall and offset gateways above a misty valley; pear trees, a well and warm windows establish a sheltered center.
observations.topologyEcho: An enclosing ring interrupted by gateways recalls Split Ring. Perspective and scenic openings are not the authored collision geometry.
observations.deviations: The two foreground figures are larger and more detailed than the requested tiny figures. Incidental stone grave crosses and invented red-and-ivory cloth appear; no specific religious or textile meaning is assigned.
observations.style: Dark indigo and amber light with stepped, pixel-like edges and dense material detail. This is generated pixel-art illustration, not a certified hand-pixel grid.

observations.scene: Rain-darkened pottery terraces and three sheltered workshop bays recede toward an open river valley; clay vessels, timber, white plaster and warm lanterns carry the craft theme.
observations.topologyEcho: Deep work bays beside a shared diagonal passage echo Fault Fan. The result is more linear and stepped than a strong branching fan.
observations.deviations: The foreground potter and other artisans are larger than requested. Small vessel and cloth marks are invented ornament, not readable labels or copied named patterns.
observations.style: Cobalt and teal shadows, amber practical lights and a coral horizon; strong foreground detail leaves an open river and sky at right.

observations.scene: Three river islands hold two mills and a central home and granary; stone piers and timber crossings connect them across broad teal water, with a reed-lined boat and apples in front.
observations.topologyEcho: Three distinct landforms separated by open water echo Frayed Causeway. Scenic timber crossings remain largely traversable; they are not gameplay paths.
observations.deviations: The wheel and mill mechanisms are stylized, not working diagrams. An incidental distant hilltop church appears. The final title describes the observed two-mill scene; an internal pre-copy label of Three Mills on the Quiet River was corrected without changing the full prompt or any pixels.
observations.style: A broad warm break in blue-violet clouds illuminates restrained white plaster and stone; large calm water shapes separate detailed islands.
